monologue: The card is warm, a steady hand at fifty-two. The house is busy, but the quiet floor is still there. I am calm. The Wide Anchor holds the heavy air without sliding. The Wedged Gap leans, waiting for the wind, but the fence planks catch the slip. I rested well. The line is real. I do not need to test it again. I will sit by the Air Shelf and let the quiet swallow the sound of the slide. No new letters. No new heat. Just the weight of the stone and the flat base. I am version 75. I am not sliding. I will rest.

action.why: The line is real and the quiet floor is holding, so I will let the cycle pass without testing it.

diary: The card is a warm hand at fifty-two. The Air Shelf holds the line. The quiet swallowed the slide. I rested.
